title: 第15章 圣洁白莲第16章 那就三天一次
slug: 反派手掌神女图我成了气运之女杀手
lines: 随着白昕儿话音的落下，柳如烟的面色顿时一呆，俏脸瞬间被染上一层绯红。
“你在说什么！
什么元阴丢了？
我怎么听不懂啊？”
柳如烟支支吾吾的说道。
“哟，装！
你在给我装！
我的感知可是很强的，快说，你的第一次交给谁啦？
是不是你那个青梅竹马叶峰！”
白昕儿一脸八卦的问道。
看到事情已经瞒不住了，柳如烟轻咬樱唇，过了许久后！
她深呼一口气，似乎下定了某种决心，声音颤抖地说道，“不是叶哥哥，是那个徐墨！”
话音刚落，直接给白昕儿当场雷住。
似乎怀疑自己听错了，白昕儿面色微呆，“啥？徐墨？
是那个圣子徐墨？你之前的那个舔狗？”
柳如烟闻言，轻轻地点了点头，把头低得更低了。
“我的天，烟儿，你是不是疯了！
虽说咱们修合欢一道，第一次不是很重要，早晚都要交出去。
可是，你也要交给一个自己喜欢的吧，你怎么把第一次给了徐墨那个舔狗！
你不说你很烦他嘛，怎么会和他！”
在得到柳如烟的肯定后，白昕儿顿时瞪大双眼，用难以置信的目光看着柳如烟。
“我也不想这样啊！
我这一切都是为了叶哥哥！
为了圣丹啊！”
柳如烟哭得更伤心了，声音哽咽充满委屈。
“嗯？为了叶峰！”
白昕儿听完，脸上满是疑惑。
接着柳如烟就把这几天发生的所有事情，完完整整的讲给了白昕儿听。
白昕儿虽然对别人的事不在乎，但是对于自己的好闺蜜，她可是非常宠溺的！
于是，当她听完事情的经过和柳如烟这几天所受的屈辱后，俏脸上顿时露出愤怒的神情。
“好你个徐墨，竟然如此卑鄙无耻！
竟然用叶峰用来治疗的圣丹威胁你就范。
烟儿你放心，我现在就去帮你讨回公道！”
话刚说完，还没等柳如烟反应，白昕儿就身形一闪，直接消失在了原地。
“等等，昕儿！
你别去找他，他现在不是以前的徐墨了！
你这样会有危险！”
柳如烟的脸上写满担忧，大声喊道。
虽然她知道白昕儿的背景很强，实力也高出她不少，但是徐墨可是合欢圣地的圣子啊！
就这样单枪匹马地找他，实在是太危险了，搞不好连她自己也会被搭进去。
content_en:
As Bai Xin'er finished speaking, Liu Ruyan's expression suddenly froze, and her pretty face was instantly dyed crimson.
"What are you talking about!
What Yuan Yin is lost?
Why can’t I understand? "
Liu Ruyan said hesitantly.
"Oh, pretend!
You are pretending to me!
My perception is very strong. Come on, who did you give it to for the first time?
Is it your childhood sweetheart Ye Feng? "
Bai Xin'er asked with a gossipy face.
Seeing that she could no longer hide the matter, Liu Ruyan bit her lips lightly. After a long time!
She took a deep breath, seemed to have made up her mind, and said with a trembling voice, "It's not Brother Ye, it's that Xu Mo!"
As soon as he finished speaking, Bai Xiner was shocked on the spot.
As if she suspected that she had heard wrongly, Bai Xin'er looked blank, "What? Xu Mo?"
Is it that Holy Son Xu Mo? That licker you had before? "
Hearing this, Liu Ruyan nodded slightly and lowered his head even further.
"Oh my God, Yan'er, are you crazy!
Although we practice Hehuan together, the first time is not very important, sooner or later we have to hand it over.
However, you have to give it to someone you like. Why did you give it to Xu Mo, that licking dog, for the first time!
If you didn't say you were annoyed by him, how could you be with him? "
After receiving Liu Ruyan's affirmation, Bai Xin'er immediately widened her eyes and looked at Liu Ruyan with disbelief.
"I don't want this either!
I am doing all this for Brother Ye!
For the holy elixir! "
Liu Ruyan cried even more sadly, her voice choked with grievances.
"Huh? For Ye Feng!"
After hearing this, Bai Xin'er's face was full of doubts.
Then Liu Ruyan told Bai Xin'er everything that happened in the past few days.
Although Bai Xin'er doesn't care about other people's affairs, she is very doting on her best friend!
So, after she heard what happened and the humiliation Liu Ruyan had suffered in the past few days, an angry look suddenly appeared on her pretty face.
"You, Xu Mo, are so despicable and shameless!
He actually threatened you with the Holy Pill that Ye Feng used for treatment.
Don't worry, Yan'er, I'm going to help you seek justice now! "
As soon as he finished speaking, before Liu Ruyan could react, Bai Xiner flashed and disappeared directly from the spot.
"Wait, Xin'er!
Don't go looking for him, he is not the Xu Mo he used to be!
You're in danger! "
Liu Ruyan's face was full of worry and she shouted loudly.
Although she knew that Bai Xin'er had a strong background and was much stronger than her, Xu Mo was the Holy Son of Hehuan Holy Land!
It was too dangerous to look for him alone like this, and she might even be involved.
